summary: The document builder directory provides components and functions for asynchronously building document sections and bullet lists, supporting translation and enablement definitions.
responsibilities: Provides builder components for generating document sections and bullet lists asynchronously.
relationships: SectionBuilder utilizes translation and enablement definitions for document sections.
build_sections coordinates building all enabled sections using section builders.
design_decisions: Asynchronous building functions are provided for generating document components like bullet lists and sections.
